 After A 71-Year-Old MAGA Supporter Revealed Why She And Her Entire Family Are “Voting Straight Red,” Christina Ricci Asked A 5-Word Question That Has Everyone Gagged
 “Never take your foot off their neck, Christina.”
 Posted on Oct 22, 2026 UTC comment 
 Facebook 
 Pinterest 
 Link 
 by Leyla Mohammed BuzzFeed BuzzFeed Staff As a Celebrity Reporter, I cover everything from fashion and award shows to TV, film, and cultural conversations.
 If there’s one thing we know about Christina Ricci, it’s that she never shies away from making brutally unfiltered commentary online — especially when it comes to politics. 
 Gilbert Flores / Getty Images
 This year alone, the Yellowjackets actor has slammed a body-shaming right-wing influencer , shaded divisive figures like Joe Rogan and Andrew Tate, and called out celebrities who attended the Bezos-sponsored Met Gala . 
 WHY IS CHRISTINA BEING MESSY pic.twitter.com/YEEWDL4xXX 
— taylor 🐧 (@shaunniballs) May 5, 2026 
 Matt Winkelmeyer / Getty Images / Via x.com 
 Now, Christina is hitting back at a 71-year-old Republican who posted on Threads about why they’ll be “voting straight Red.” 
 Jon Kopaloff / Getty Images
 “I’m 71 and my whole family in California, Texas and Arizona, and Michigan, plus Pensilvania will be voting straight Red. We don’t want a communist representing us. We are MAGA. And we won’t bend to them,” the user wrote. 
 Anna Moneymaker / Getty Images
 Christina’s response? Well, she started with a simple five-word question : “So you’re a sadist then?” 
 Tap to play GIF 
 Tap to play GIF
 Paramount Pictures / giphy.com 
 She then followed up: “You enjoy other people suffering? Because that’s what you voted for- more cruelty and suffering for your fellow human beings. And animals actually.” 
 @riccigrams / Via threads.com 
 Reddit users immediately had LOTS of praise for Christina’s unfiltered response. “Like usual she's right. Miss Ricci is forever the GOAT,” one person said , while another wrote , “I love celebs who go hard on social media.” 
 Rich Polk / Getty Images
 “Never take your foot off their neck, Christina,” someone said . “I LOVE HER. She is alllllll over Threads being fierce and unapologetically furious at the injustice and evil around us,” another comment read . 
 Kevin Winter / Getty Images
 “Christina has always been one of my favorite actresses,” one user wrote , to which someone else replied , “Same. A delight in everything she’s involved in especially her no holds back posts. Very Wednesday of her.”
 Let us know what you think in the comments!
